`two-lists.json` is a small u6 trie produced by the pinned `@serverless-dns/trie` builder, not a copy of a production blocklist. List 0 contains `listed.example`; list 1 contains `other.example` and 48 synthetic `.test` names (the first eight hex digits of SHA-256 of the decimal numbers 0 through 47). The extra entries exercise the rank directory. `td` and `rd` are the base64-encoded `td.txt` and `rd.txt`; the two metadata objects are the builder’s matching outputs.
